obligations.expected_behavior: Exactly one repository-owned pytest terminal selection executes every Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration case.
obligations.observable_result: One repository-owned terminal pytest selection is present and reports execution coverage for all four Package A case categories: unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration.
obligations.state_after: The single repository-owned pytest terminal selection has executed all required Package A case categories.
obligations.state_before: A Package A pytest terminal validation is initiated.
obligations.subject: Repository-owned pytest terminal selection
obligations.trigger: When Package A validation is run

obligations.expected_behavior: Each executed Package A case has an independently evaluated expected result.
obligations.observable_result: The pytest results expose an independent expected-result assertion for every Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration case.
obligations.state_after: Every executed Package A case has its own expected-result outcome.
obligations.state_before: Package A cases are selected for terminal execution.
obligations.subject: Package A case result evaluation
obligations.trigger: When each selected Package A case completes

obligations.expected_behavior: The validation provides explicit mappings from each Package A case to its assertions.
obligations.observable_result: A case-to-assertion mapping is available for all Package A unit, boundary, negative, and CLI integration cases.
obligations.state_after: Every required Package A case has an explicit case/assertion mapping.
obligations.state_before: Package A cases and assertions are defined for validation.
obligations.subject: Package A case/assertion mapping
obligations.trigger: When Package A validation artifacts are inspected

obligations.expected_behavior: Required cases cannot produce a passing terminal result when any required case is missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, reduced to zero executed cases, or affected by a harness error.
forbidden_result: A required case is missing while the terminal selection passes.
A required case is skipped while the terminal selection passes.
A required case is deselected while the terminal selection passes.
A required case is xfailed while the terminal selection passes.
The required case set executes zero cases while the terminal selection passes.
A harness error affects required cases while the terminal selection passes.
obligations.observable_result: The terminal selection fails or is prevented from passing whenever any listed required-case condition occurs.
obligations.state_after: The terminal validation cannot pass with any listed missing, skipped, deselected, xfailed, zero-case, or harness-error condition affecting required cases.
obligations.state_before: Required Package A cases are subject to terminal pass/fail evaluation.
obligations.subject: Required-case pass gating
obligations.trigger: When the repository-owned pytest terminal selection evaluates required Package A cases

obligations.expected_behavior: A negative fixture that is rejected as expected is counted as a passing test.
obligations.observable_result: The negative fixture's expected rejection is reported as a passed test assertion.
obligations.state_after: The expected rejection is recorded as a passing negative test.
obligations.state_before: A negative fixture is executed with rejection defined as its expected outcome.
obligations.subject: Negative fixture result handling
obligations.trigger: When a negative fixture is rejected as expected

obligations.expected_behavior: Rejecting a negative fixture as expected does not cause the overall pytest suite to fail.
forbidden_result: The overall pytest suite is marked failed solely because a negative fixture was rejected as expected.
obligations.observable_result: The suite-level result remains passing when the negative fixture rejection matches its expected outcome.
obligations.state_after: The overall suite passes despite the expected negative-fixture rejection.
obligations.state_before: The suite contains a negative fixture whose expected outcome is rejection.
obligations.subject: Suite-level negative-test aggregation
obligations.trigger: After a negative fixture is rejected as expected
